todos.description: Refactor scripts/predict_tc.py: remove all duplicate function definitions (predict_tc defined 4x, train_model 3x, average_valence 2x, average_debye 2x, average_atomic_mass 2x, mcmillan_tc 2x, allen_dynes_tc 2x, main 3x, generate_candidates 2x, structure_to_graph 2x, train_gnn 2x, predict_with_uncertainty 2x, train_gp_model 2x). Keep exactly one canonical version of each. Fix the module-level TRAINING_DATA redefinition that calls load_database() on non-existent 'superconductor_data.json' — use lazy-loading instead. This is the core ML prediction engine for the discovery pipeline.

Fix run_pipeline.py: (1) Create scripts/output_ranked.py with a run() function that ranks candidates by predicted Tc, or replace all 6+ references to the non-existent 'output_ranked' module with inline logic. (2) Fix the truncated 'st.su' syntax error at end of file (change to 'st.success("Feedback saved!")' or remove the incomplete statement). (3) Remove the duplicate main() function definition (one at line ~200, another at line ~4900) and the duplicate if __name__ == '__main__' blocks. These defects prevent the pipeline from executing.

Deduplicate and restructure proposed_chemistry_physics.md: remove all repeated sections (Manufacturing Pathways appears as section 3 and again standalone, Synthesis Protocols appears twice, Chemical Precompression appears as section 3 and embedded in section 5), fix broken section numbering (multiple ##2./##3./##4. headings), consolidate all synthesis protocols into one section and all manufacturing pathways into one section. Add missing critical physics: anharmonic phonon effects in hydrides (Errea et al., Nature 2020), the 135 K cuprate ceiling and strategies to break it, quantum critical point framework for cuprates/nickelates, and a dedicated 4-stage manufacturing scale-up roadmap (DAC µg → multi-anvil mg → Paris-Edinburgh g → large-volume press kg) with equipment specs and cost estimates.
